UpdateSourceArgs: -c "export WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine\" WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES=\"mscoree,mshtml=\"; (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/27017) 2>/dev/null && { echo \"MongoDB is already running\"; exit 0; }; mkdir -p \"{{$FullRootDir}}mongo-data\" && cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}cloud/mongodb\" && exec /usr/bin/wine mongod.exe --dbpath \"Z:{{$FullRootDir}}mongo-data\" --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port 27017 --smallfiles --logpath \"Z:{{$FullRootDir}}mongo-data/mongod.log\" --logappend"

-NoProfile -Command "try { $c = [Net.Sockets.TcpClient]::new('127.0.0.1', 27017); $c.Close(); Write-Output 'MongoDB is already running'; exit 0 } catch {}; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '{{$FullRootDir}}mongo-data' | Out-Null; Set-Location '{{$FullBaseDir}}cloud\mongodb'; & .\mongod.exe --dbpath '{{$FullRootDir}}mongo-data' --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port 27017 --smallfiles --logpath '{{$FullRootDir}}mongo-data\mongod.log' --logappend"

-c "for i in $(seq 1 90); do (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/27017) 2>/dev/null && { echo \"MongoDB is up\"; exit 0; }; sleep 1; done; echo \"MongoDB did not start within 90s, see mongo-data/mongod.log. Aborting\"; exit 1"

-NoProfile -Command "for ($i = 0; $i -lt 90; $i++) { try { $c = [Net.Sockets.TcpClient]::new('127.0.0.1', 27017); $c.Close(); Write-Output 'MongoDB is up'; exit 0 } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } }; Write-Output 'MongoDB did not start within 90s, see mongo-data\mongod.log. Aborting'; exit 1"
